description: This file defines a ProductRepository class that serves as a data access layer for product-related database operations in an e-commerce backend. It includes methods for retrieving, counting, creating, and managing products, along with their descriptions, images, and relationships, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM.

classes.name: ProductRepository
classes.description: Repository class for accessing product data from the database, providing various methods for fetching, counting, and creating products.

methods.description: Retrieves a list of products with optional filters including category, search terms, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: int count( self, category_id: Optional[int] = None, search: Optional[str] = None, language_id: int = 1 )
methods.description: Returns the number of products matching provided filters.

methods.description: Retrieves URLs of images associated with a specific product.

methods.description: Creates a new product entry along with its description in the database.
